what: Janela's measured REGIONS beyond the eight open-sea sites of 2026-10-06. ONE definition: each region names its sites (in sites.json) and every path of its own chain — the back-archive cache (git-ignored) and pack, the matchups, the calibrated bands, the site alpha — and the ledger proposer its bands record defines. A region is measured and lends bands the day its records are committed; the records of 2026-10-06 (corpus/janela/{ecmwf,alt,matchups.json.gz}, certs/janela-{bands,alpha}.json, proposer calibrated-v1) are never rewritten to add one.

sergipe.caveatPt: a faixa de Sergipe é medida contra o mar que o satélite vê a 40–100 km da costa, mais fundo e mais agitado que a água rasa das plataformas: puxa para CIMA — conservadora por construção. Um ondógrafo nas plataformas fecharia essa diferença.
sergipe.caveat: The platforms stand in 13-38 m of water 5-20 km off the coast, where an altimeter footprint is land-contaminated: the passes that count (547 in three years, >= 5 points within 100 km) see the sea 40-100 km out (median mean distance 70 km), deeper and rougher than at the platforms, while the forecast is read at the model's sea node 5 km off the coast. The measured ratio band therefore carries the shelf's gradient as well as the model's error (Hs at 24 h: 1.13-1.62 x the forecast, against 0.86-1.20 at Santos): it leans HIGH for the platforms — conservative by construction, and stated wherever it decides.
